title: GrantThai project.yaml — the one canonical input
description: Draft (structure only; no validator/renderer implementation yet). This is the ONLY input `grantthai build` reads (spec/contracts/one-input-one-output.md). Every editor (webform, forms/*.md, interview questionnaires, `grantthai init`, optional AI assist) writes this same file. Identity and team data used in a submission live here, in PROFILE.* fields (copied from the optional profile.yaml at authoring time); build never reads profile.yaml. The fund profile is a bound reference looked up from fund_binding.fund_profile_id. derived_from: core/01@sha256:c177c28034a71bd8dfb65965e5bba81efac9ef68e9e0d5c6ba1ed0f1f2cf8512 (overall project object concept), core/02@sha256:d36e6922a01296bd5001733ca7d5e1d2f6927fbcc08ffebde176d0d2159535a4 (field/tab structure), core/04@sha256:c23217441176d90f129e525248c24103575bcd85841020b2842fd237638d269a (lifecycle/provenance), core/06@sha256:e0f787dab03ef73c2596e91ca603f2bbdf598774c0f1623bae9e388413365d1d (DAG/KG shape).

mode.description: All modes compile to this same project.yaml.

tools_disclosed.description: Legacy flat list of disclosed tool names (kept for older files and the frontmatter). Since the AI-use ceiling (docs/policy/ai-use-ceiling.md), ai_use_declaration.tools carries name, version, stages and purpose.

fund_profile_id.description: <agency>/<call-id>@<major.minor>; the profile is read from funds/<fund_profile_id>/fund-profile.yaml (e.g. example/FICTIONAL_CALL@0.1). See spec/fund/fund-profile.schema.json.

form_profile.description: v0.2: id of a form profile in mappings/nriis/form_profiles/ (spec/mappings/form_profile.schema.json), e.g. ff_full_proposal@nriis-2570. Absent or null = the observed form (mappings/nriis/section_to_tab.yaml). Every profile is NEEDS_VERIFICATION. Authored content: changing it changes content_sha256.

fields.description: Project-level field records: every registry field whose chain_node is null (e.g. titles, keywords, team, requested budget).

chain.description: Chain content keyed by a spec/common/chain.yaml core or bridge node. Each value is an array of field records.

sources.description: The project's source registry (spec/common/source.schema.json). `source_ids` in field records resolve here; see spec/common/links-and-sources.md.

lock.description: The object-level LOCK (not the same as a field's LOCKED status; see spec/common/status.yaml).

locked_content_sha256.description: content_sha256 at lock time (spec/common/object-hash.md). The lock is broken when the current content_sha256 differs.

ai_use_declaration.description: The researcher's own AI Use Declaration, rendered as a GrantThai appendix in NRIIS_SUBMISSION.md (section 4.7). Its shape follows the sample form in Appendix A (p.34) of the national GenAI research-ethics guideline (September 2569; docs/sources.md, docs/policy/ai-use-ceiling.md). It is NOT an NRIIS field: whether NRIIS or a fund asks for it is NEEDS_VERIFICATION. Self-declared and unverified. AI surfaces (set_field with actor ai_assisted: CLI --ai, MCP, HTTP, the skill script) may only add or extend tools[] entries (name, version, stage); every other key is the researcher's, and declaration_confirmed_by_human is set only by the researcher editing project.yaml. When an AI surface changes tools[], declaration_confirmed_by_human is reset to false.

tools.description: One entry per AI tool used (guideline p.11-12, p.34 items 3-4).

version.description: Model or product version (p.12 item 7.1). NEEDS_INPUT until the researcher states it.

purpose.description: What the tool was used for (p.11, p.34 item 4). NEEDS_INPUT until the researcher states it.

used_on.description: When it was used, free text such as a date or a date range (p.12 item 7.1).

influence_on_conclusions.description: How the AI output influenced decisions or conclusions (p.11 item 2).

human_verification.description: What the researcher checked, how, and who signs for it (p.12 item 4, p.34 item 7).

data_handling.description: Which TYPES of data were given to the AI and how personal or confidential data was kept out (p.14-16, p.34 item 5). Describe the type; never paste the data itself.

log_ref.description: Where the researcher keeps the prompt and output log, tool versions and dates (p.12-13 item 7). A reference, not the log.

risk_self_assessment.description: The researcher's own scores, 1-3, on the five dimensions of the guideline's example scoring table (p.10-11, marked there as an example only). The guideline gives no rule for combining the five scores; any single level GrantThai prints is GrantThai's own convention (the highest score), never the guideline's.

declaration_confirmed_by_human.description: True only when the researcher has read the whole declaration and confirms they checked every AI-assisted value and take full responsibility (p.12 item 4, p.15 item 2.3, p.34 item 8). Never set by an AI surface.

confirmed_by.description: Name or role of the person who confirmed (the researcher's choice).

ai_use_stage.description: Research stage (docs/policy/ai-use-ceiling.md section 2). 'review' means reviewing the project's own drafts, never reviewing someone else's work.
